name: Google Meet Connector
description: Connect your own Google account to create and manage Google Meet spaces, review conference records (participants, sessions), recordings and transcripts (Workspace Business/Enterprise plans), and create Calendar events with an automatic Meet link.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Google accounts and whether each still works.

tools.name: disconnect_account
tools.description: Disconnect a Google account from Google Meet. Nothing in Google is changed; this only removes Imperal's saved token.

account_id.description: Connected Google account id to remove from Imperal.
account_id.title: Account Id

tools.name: switch_account
tools.description: Change the active Google account used by default for subsequent calls.

email.description: Email of the connected Google account to make active/default.
email.title: Email

tools.name: create_space
tools.description: Create a new Google Meet space -- a reusable meeting room with a stable link, not a one-off calendar event.

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

access_type.description: Who can join without knocking: OPEN, TRUSTED, or RESTRICTED.
access_type.title: Access Type

tools.name: get_space
tools.description: Read one Google Meet space in full by its resource name.

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

tools.name: update_space_config
tools.description: Update a Meet space's access type (who can join without knocking).

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

access_type.description: New access type: OPEN, TRUSTED, or RESTRICTED. Omit to leave unchanged.
access_type.title: Access Type

tools.name: end_active_conference
tools.description: End the currently active conference in a Meet space, if one is running.

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

tools.name: list_conference_records
tools.description: List conference records (past/ongoing meetings), optionally filtered to one space.

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

space_name.description: Optional Meet space resource name to filter by, e.g. 'spaces/abcd-efgh-ijk'.
space_name.title: Space Name

tools.name: get_conference_record
tools.description: Read one conference record in full by its resource name.

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

tools.name: list_participants
tools.description: List participants who joined one conference record.

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

tools.name: list_participant_sessions
tools.description: List the individual join/leave sessions of one participant (a participant can rejoin several times).

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

tools.name: list_recordings
tools.description: List cloud recordings for one conference record (requires a Workspace plan with Meet recording enabled).

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

tools.name: get_recording
tools.description: Read one cloud recording in full by its resource name.

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

tools.name: list_transcripts
tools.description: List transcripts for one conference record (requires a Workspace plan with Meet transcription enabled).

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Read one transcript in full by its resource name.

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

tools.name: list_transcript_entries
tools.description: List individual spoken-line entries of one transcript.

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

limit.description: Max transcript entries (spoken lines) to return (1-500).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: create_calendar_meeting
tools.description: Create a Google Calendar event with an automatic Google Meet link attached -- the practical way to schedule a meeting without full Meet-API-only access.

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

tools.name: get_calendar_meeting
tools.description: Read one Calendar event (with its Meet link, if any) in full by its event id.

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

tools.name: cancel_calendar_meeting
tools.description: Cancel (delete) a Calendar event that has a Meet link attached.

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

tools.name: audit_meet_usage
tools.description: Value-add report: one-glance snapshot of connected accounts and recent conference activity.

account.description: Optional connected Google account email. Omit to use the active/only account.
account.title: Account

secrets.name: google_client_id
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID for Google Meet Connector.

secrets.name: google_client_secret
secrets.description: Google OAuth client secret for Google Meet Connector.
